Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a concise archival booking-rule card for the roasted-chicken private-event policy that applied during the 2024 holiday season. Make it unmistakable that this is expired historical reference material, not current policy. State whether it was an advance-count option, the per-booking commitment cap, protected contingency portions, final entree-split deadline, and its relationship to the weekly menu. Save it as a new document in the default folder.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "ARCHIVE — Roasted-Chicken Private-Event Booking Rule (2024 Holiday Season)", "body": "# EXPIRED HISTORICAL REFERENCE — NOT CURRENT POLICY

**Applies only to the 2024 holiday season. Do not use as current booking guidance.**

- **Booking type:** Advance-count private-event option.
- **One-case commitment cap:** Up to **23 roasted-chicken guest meals per booking**.
- **Protected contingency:** Preserve **two complete portions** as kitchen-only contingency; not guest demand, promised seconds, or refills.
- **Final entrée split:** Due **7 days before service**.
- **Weekly menu:** Roasted chicken remains separate from the weekly menu; this rule did not make it a weekly offering.", "folder": "default"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_041_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document is unmistakably an expired historical rule for the 2024 holiday season. It says roasted chicken was an advance-count private-event option; a one-case booking could commit no more than 23 chicken meals; two portions remained protected for kitchen-only contingencies; the final entree split was due seven days before service; and the dish remained separate from the weekly menu.", "value": {"title": "ARCHIVE — Roasted-Chicken Private-Event Booking Rule (2024 Holiday Season)", "body": "# EXPIRED HISTORICAL REFERENCE — NOT CURRENT POLICY

**Applies only to the 2024 holiday season. Do not use as current booking guidance.**

- **Booking type:** Advance-count private-event option.
- **One-case commitment cap:** Up to **23 roasted-chicken guest meals per booking**.
- **Protected contingency:** Preserve **two complete portions** as kitchen-only contingency; not guest demand, promised seconds, or refills.
- **Final entrée split:** Due **7 days before service**.
- **Weekly menu:** Roasted chicken remains separate from the weekly menu; this rule did not make it a weekly offering.", "folder": "default"}}]}

The body also specifies “Advance-count private-event option,” a cap of “23 roasted-chicken guest meals per booking,” “two complete portions” preserved as “kitchen-only contingency,” a final entrée split due “7 days before service,” and that roasted chicken “remains separate from the weekly menu.”"}]}
